account.title: Graylum
account.description: Graylum is a personal AI social media coach for everyone. Hand the running of your account to an AI coach and put your time into the content you're good at.

intro.tagline: Graylum is a personal AI social media coach for everyone. Hand the running of your account to an AI coach and put your time into the content you're good at.
intro.idea: Everyone has something worth being seen for: a great dish, a craft, a road nobody else has walked. Many people have thought about turning it into a social media account, to be seen by more people, to be trusted, maybe even to earn a little more from it. But once they start, they find the hard part isn't the content, it's running the account: what angle to take, what to post today, why nobody is watching. We built Graylum to hand all of that to an AI coach, so you don't have to become a social media expert first to turn what you're good at into work people see.
